//: Extends the service flavour so that this file carries no compiler option of its own - the two
decorator flags moved to packages/config/tsconfig.service.json because §5.3 says 'Compiler
options are never redefined per workspace - change the base', and a NestJS app is an app type
this repo has, so it gets its flavour like every other workspace gets one. See that file's own
comment for why the flags could not simply go into tsconfig.node.json.
`include` is local by §5.3's own list (rootDir, include, exclude, paths) and is a feature-index:
a new feature directory under src/ must be added here or it is not a root of the program. It is
not the set of files typechecked - everything these import is in the program too, which is why
src/payments, src/shipping, src/sms and src/storage are absent from this list and still checked.
